interrogation.moment: A person like me. Wants to quickly shoot thoughts, ideas, todos and have them visible and clear. Few things done well. Wants to feel in charge of the day - not losing bills to pay, tracking new ideas. Modern yet warm.
interrogation.appsThatFeelRight: Linear's modern restraint resonated, but wants something different/bolder. Tiimo (editorial serif, soft personality) was the only to-do reference that landed. Rejected pastel-illustration journaling apps as 'sucks'.
interrogation.almostGetsIt: Current Synapse 'Kinetic Equilibrium' system - feels too corporate. New Yorker: loves the pastel category-card palette that works in both light and dark.
interrogation.first3Seconds: Activating. Must see entire notes/ideas/todos at a glance on home (user is ADHD - out of sight = out of mind). Items must be actionable, not just count-labels.
interrogation.offLimits: Corporate. Gamified/habit-tracker. Pastel-illustration mush. Pure white/pure black.
interrogation.toolCompanionStage: tool (capture-first, gets thoughts down fast) with warm human voice

references.lesson: Desaturated pastel category cards (powder blue, peach, sage, blush, lavender, butter) + ink-line icons + serif labels. Pastels survive both light and dark mode.
Tiny all-caps kicker + big serif headline + italic serif deck. Editorial reverence for content.
Huge stacked serif title on warm cream, bold through scale and emptiness.
Editorial serif date header, soft warm personality, not corporate.
Drenched terracotta color-block header - warmth by zone, not tint.

hardRequirements: True light + dark mode parity (light is first-class, not an afterthought)
No pure white / no pure black - warm off-whites and warm-tinted darks
Warm human headline summary at top of home
Everything at a glance on home - actionable items visible, color-coded by type, not dead count tiles
Pastel category color system per entry type
currentSystemRejectedBecause: too corporate; documented blue-lavender calm but code is actually warm/red and incoherent (20 perceived colors, 418 hardcoded values)
